lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho₂Ti₈Sn₄ (reduced formula HoTi₄Sn₂) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies two tetrahedral motifs: Ho centers coordinated by four Sn neighbors and Sn centers coordinated by four Ti neighbors, alongside Ti centers coordinated by two Ho and two Sn neighbors, all at 2.726 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show corner-sharing between Ho–Sn, Sn–Ti, and Ti–Ti tetrahedra.
